name: Nursery Summoner
prompt: Create ONE new Splitter SUMMONER slime enemy for Math on Mars. Gameplay concept: this creature summons small slimes while alive; NOT two creatures joined together and NOT splitting in half on death. Use attached Drifter as STYLE reference only. Smooth very simple cartoon illustration, thick clean dark navy outlines, single straight front-facing orientation, level symmetrical mischievous dark eyes and tiny smile. Purple/lavender jelly body with a pale-yellow spawning core. STRICT FLAT SOLID COLORS, NO shadows, shading, gradients, glare, highlights, glow, texture or translucency. Show summoning role through large readable organic shapes, not visual effects or complex detail. No mechanical equipment, wizard clothing, staffs, armor or weapons. Single whole centered creature on solid bright blue key background, generous margins, square image. No floor, cast shadow, text, labels, UI or detached extra creatures. Design A: round pear-shaped purple parent slime with two small rounded bud protrusions attached low on its sides, like developing jelly offspring without faces. Large central pale-yellow oval brood sac marked with exactly three simple small purple egg-shaped dots arranged triangularly. One short soft crest on top, squat scalloped base. Kind of mischievous alien nursery, one face total, one continuous body, no splitting seam.
notes: Splitter reinterpreted as summoner per user correction. No animation or runtime integration.
